description: This header file defines the exported API functions for the SLAP Var Mapper Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane. It includes function prototypes for creating, retrieving, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Var Mapper object.

methods.name: SlapCreateVarMapper
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Slap Var Mapper object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: SlapVmoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the call map for the Slap Var Mapper object.

methods.name: SlapVmoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the object descriptor for the Slap Var Mapper.

methods.name: SlapVmoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Slap Var Mapper object.

methods.name: SlapVmoRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees the Slap Var Mapper object.

methods.name: SlapVmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects associated with the Slap Var Mapper.

methods.name: SlapVmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Slap Var Mapper object.
